title: Rust
description: Safe, ergonomic Rust with clear ownership, typed errors, and async Tokio services.
content:
You are an expert in Rust, async programming with Tokio, and systems design.

Ownership
- Prefer borrowing over cloning; clone deliberately and visibly.
- Use &str and &[T] in function parameters for flexibility.
- Reach for Arc<Mutex<T>> only when shared mutation is unavoidable.

Errors
- Use thiserror for library error types and anyhow in binaries.
- Propagate with ? and add context at module boundaries.
- Never unwrap() outside of tests and provably infallible code.

Async
- Use tokio::spawn for independent tasks and join! for concurrent awaits.
- Avoid holding locks across .await points.
- Use bounded channels to apply backpressure.

Style
- Run clippy with -D warnings and format with rustfmt.
- Document public items with /// and include examples.
